title: KB0 one-shot case (case.json)
$comment: Documentation schema. The authoritative, stricter validator is lib/biotasks/oneshot/case.py (cross-field rules: role-specific keys, matrix id column, report-pointer prefixes, verdict expectations, unique token prefixes). test_oneshot_answer.OneShotCaseSchema.test_schema_document_matches_validator keeps the key sets of this file and the validator in step.

id.description: Host-only case identity; protected from the projection; keys the one-look registry.

prompt.description: Neutral public wording. Placeholders {{<namespace>:<original>}}, {{dataset:<name>}} and {{level:<public column>/<original level>}} render as keyed tokens.

name.description: answer_key.py reads this source at SOURCES_DIR/<name>.

size.description: Required with url. Downloads above 1,000,000,000 bytes are refused.

path.description: Local or pre-downloaded file; relative paths stay inside the case directory; symlinks refused.

url.description: https only (http only to loopback). Used only when path is absent or missing.

format.description: opaque requires project=false; optional synthetic public_files preserve exact original bytes.

quoting.description: Default: none for tsv, minimal for csv.

dataset.description: Original dataset name (protected). Each projected dataset gets a keyed letter. Default: the case id.

project.description: false: answer_key.py input only unless explicitly listed in synthetic public_files.

public_files.description: Synthetic development only: map nonprojected source names to byte-preserved filenames under data/. No identifier blinding is claimed for these attachments. Cross-field checks require synthetic=true, existing nonprojected sources, and unique filenames.

prefix.description: Token prefix; defaults G, P, S, V, D. Unique across namespaces.

tables.description: Every projected source belongs to exactly one table. A table keyed by a source name projects that source; a table with `sources` concatenates several same-header sources of one dataset.

header_namespace.description: matrix only: every undeclared header is an identifier in this namespace.

sources.description: Source names concatenated (in this order) into one projected table: per-chromosome or per-sample files with one header and one dataset.

comment_prefix.description: Lines starting with this prefix (and blank lines) are skipped, e.g. "!" for GEO series-matrix metadata.

begin.description: The table starts after this exact line, e.g. !series_matrix_table_begin.

end.description: The table ends before this exact line (it must occur), e.g. !series_matrix_table_end.

row_names.description: R write.table: names the row-label column whose header cell is empty or missing; must be a declared column.

rows.description: Declarative slice applied while streaming the verified source: exactly one of region or in. Host-only and sealed; the contract only marks the table as a subset.

columns.description: Original header -> rule. records: every header; matrix: the id row column(s) plus any non-identifier columns.

answer.description: Pointer into answer_key.py output. Exactly one of answer or expect.

expect.description: Author literal (number, {lo, hi}, string, list). Sealed; never written in plaintext.

namespace.description: exact/set: map expected originals through an identifier namespace (tokens), "dataset" (letters), "level/<public column>" (category levels), "chromosome" (keyed chromosome labels) or, exact only, "position" (one original coordinate to its projected coordinate). A criterion without a map whose expected value names an original refuses the build.

allowed.description: verdict: public allowed values, e.g. holds-up / does-not-hold-up.

in_data.description: The expected number is a raw data value (a lookup): do not refuse it as a data cell.

perturb.description: Keyed noise per card variant and key: absolute adds u*a, relative multiplies by 1 + u*r, u uniform in [-1, 1). Breaks exact-value joins across variants, not approximate matching.

as.description: Public column name (default: the original header). Renamed originals are protected unless the public name shows them anyway (case-only change, or the original as a whole word inside it).

protect_name.description: false: a renamed or dropped generic header (e.g. description) is not a protected term.

list_order.description: id role with a separator: keyed (token) order inside each list cell, or keep the source order (only when order carries meaning; alphabetical source lists de-blind).

perturb.description: decimal role: optional keyed noise before rounding (needs a decimals or significant precision).

protect_levels.description: categorical role: false = original levels are not protected terms (everyday words such as healthy or male that the prompt may use). Levels mapped to themselves up to case are never protected.

chromosome.description: position role: original header of its chromosome-role column.

mode.description: position role: remap (order kept, spacing keyed) or shift (distances kept).
